reason: The fact is only partly true. Rerunning tools/trainlab.official_eval on the exp56, K2 and exp57b dummy CSVs (_dl/) against train/<stem>.geff gives division TP/FP/FN 0/0/0 on 44b6_0113de3b, 44b6_0b24845f and 6bba_05b6850b, but 0/0/3 on 6bba_05db0fb1. That clip's GT geff has 3 divisions (out-degree >= 2; 1,229 nodes). So 'no matchable GT divisions' and 'division 0/0/0' are false for 1 of the 4 clips; the finding checked only 05b6850b. The fork totals hold: 62 (exp56) and 75 (K2), and tp_forks and fp_forks are empty everywhere, so every current dummy fork is metric-ignored. The consequence holds for REMOVAL riders only. forkmid and forkblob can only delete ignored forks, so they cannot move the dummies' division score. For ADDITIVE riders (the K3b DeepCenter threshold, insertion) it is wrong: they can turn some of the 3 FN into TP or add FP forks on 05db0fb1. 'Can never show benefit' is therefore false. Such a signal would still be in-sample, because 05db0fb1 is in split.json excluded.x138_probable_train, so it is not private evidence either way. The value is low. The practical rule ('a clean dummy is plumbing, not safety') is already implicit: FINAL_REPORT §e gates 3-5 are node-equality and edge-diff gates, and CONTEXT L7 already calls dummy-local deltas in-sample artefacts. Feasibility is trivial (a CONTEXT note, no code, no runtime, R1-R10 unaffected). The wording as written must not go into CONTEXT verbatim, because it records a false fact.
fix: Record this corrected version next to the forkblob '15 of 62 flagged' note: 'Dummy twins (test == train zarr): GT divisions 0/0/0/3 (44b6_0113de3b, 44b6_0b24845f, 6bba_05b6850b, 6bba_05db0fb1). On exp56, K2 and exp57b dummies every predicted fork (62 / 75 / 74) is metric-ignored (division TP 0, FP 0), and the 3 GT divisions of 05db0fb1 are all FN. So fork-removal riders (forkmid, forkblob) cannot show division harm or benefit on dummies. An additive rider (K3b, insertion) can show FN->TP or new FP only on 05db0fb1, which is an x138 probable-train stem (in-sample). A dummy result is plumbing evidence only and is never cited as safety or value evidence. The exp60 lab (plus the L6 extension) is the only harm bed.' Optional: have the K3b dummy gate print the division TP/FP/FN on 05db0fb1 as INFO only, never as a gate.
realistic_gain: 0.000 LB. It is a documentation guard against misreading a K3/K3b dummy. The original wording would have planted a false fact (0/0/0 on all 4 clips) in CONTEXT, and the corrected wording avoids that.
